business_summary: Crossfor Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture, import, and sale of jewelry and diamonds, and accessories in Japan and internationally. It offers its products under the Crossfor and EXL-LOCK, and Dancing Stone brand names. The company also holds secondhand dealer license for watches and jewelry goods. It also operates online store. The company was formerly known as Shibado K.K. and changed its name to Crossfor Co.,Ltd. in November 2002. Crossfor Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Kofu, Japan.
